method: Independent analytical relationships and numerical boundary, periodicity or coefficient checks; rendered correspondence reviewed separately.
conditions: Small-amplitude lumped Helmholtz cavity, fixed effective neck length and area, cavity dimensions much smaller than wavelength; losses neglected. Bottle is labeled schematic, water level illustrates cavity-volume change rather than calibrated vessel volume. Neck vibration is illustrative slow motion, not literal acoustic speed. Tones represent selected resonances, not a recorded bottle.
